title: Untitled (Anti-Meme), 2026
object: Framed archival plate, 12 x 12 in, black maple frame, museum glass. Numbered edition of 500. Certificate of non-circulation included.
wall_label: An anti-meme is an idea that resists transmission. It is not secret and it is not censored. It simply fails to survive the journey. It requires too much context, offers too little feeling, and rewards nobody who repeats it. This plate has never been screenshotted successfully. Attempts return a rectangle.

notes.Certificate text: This object has not been shared. It is not expected to be.

shop_copy: The only artifact in the shop that will not travel.
